about_the_game:
In Deadly Chance, you are forced to confront the terror of a house filled with mysteries and unspeakable horrors. With each step, you become further entangled in a nightmare where pain and fear intertwine, pushing your psychological and physical limits. In a dark environment full of secrets beyond human comprehension, every decision could be your last.

Your only chance of survival is to unravel the mysteries surrounding your captivity and uncover the truth behind your torment. But beware: in the darkness, only the sharpest minds have any hope of escape. Every corner hides a threat, and fear becomes more than just an emotion—it’s a constant battle for survival.

Features:

  • Psychological Horror Atmosphere: Explore a dark house filled with horrors, where every corner holds something unexpected. Fear and tension are tangible every second.

  • Choices with Consequences: Your decisions shape the story. Each choice could be your last and directly impact your chances of survival.

  • Intense and Emotional Narrative: Uncover the truth behind your captivity as you navigate dark secrets and face relentless challenges.

content_descriptors.notes: this game contains scenes of explicit violence and gore

short_description: Deadly Chance is a psychological horror where you play as a prisoner in an aristocratic mansion. Explore, find clues, and face tough choices as hidden horrors test your sanity. Every decision matters—survival demands more than strength, but the courage to face the unknown.
